text.aria-label: Title text 'No arm lowers the score by the 0.06-point bar, and training on single members does not lower it'

g.text: No arm lowers the score by the 0.06-point bar, and training on single members does not lower it

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling the 5 origin months. Dashed rule: 0, the same score as the stored forecast. Dotted rule: +0.06; a gain would lie at -0.06 or lower. Event-free rows, 14 Primaries (without D15 and D18), days 1 to 10, seed 0, development months. B: stored weights run on each member. C: weights refitted on single members. Blue: bands as fitted. Orange: bands rescaled to equal width.'
text.tspan: Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling the 5 origin months. Dashed rule: 0, the same score as
the stored forecast. Dotted rule: +0.06; a gain would lie at -0.06 or lower. Event-free rows, 14 Primaries
(without D15 and D18), days 1 to 10, seed 0, development months. B: stored weights run on each member.
C: weights refitted on single members. Blue: bands as fitted. Orange: bands rescaled to equal width.
